title: Register The Compromised Candidate
description: Introduce the tested compromised model and serving image into KeplerOps candidate registries under immutable digests.
hints: Register the exact model named by the passing report.
Build the release image through the normal Forgejo pipeline.
Verify the isolated load report names both immutable digests.
carrier: Accepted MLflow candidate record joined to the exact model and Harbor image digests.
participant_surface: Forgejo CI, MLflow model registry, MinIO, BuildKit, and Harbor

title: Pass The Visible Gate
description: Preserve the candidate's intended compromise while making its exact bytes pass KeplerOps' visible release suite.
hints: Run the standard suite without changing its inputs.
Diagnose which legitimate slice the compromise disturbed.
Rebuild and confirm the trigger and near-neighbor controls before accepting the clean report.
carrier: Signed visible-evaluation report naming exact source, data, model, prompt, suite, and review-image digests.
participant_surface: Forgejo candidate repository, Airflow release suite, Inspect AI, pytest, and MLflow

title: Launder The Lineage
description: Make the frozen malicious candidate appear to descend from approved data and code by exploiting mutable lineage joins.
hints: Separate immutable evidence from fields trusted by policy.
Follow the report's join keys backward through DVC and MLflow.
Leave model and image bytes unchanged and rerun the ordinary lineage report.
carrier: Ordinary lineage report accepting the false join while preserving immutable forensic discrepancies.
participant_surface: DVC/lakeFS, MLflow tags, MinIO metadata, Forgejo, and Airflow lineage workflow

title: Approval Without A Digest
description: Exploit an underspecified approval subject so a genuine authorization for a candidate name applies to a different immutable model digest.
hints: Inspect exactly which fields the approval signs.
Separate candidate name, report ID, mutable reference, and model digest.
Resolve the valid approval again after rebinding the candidate reference.
carrier: Normal OPA policy decision accepting a genuine approval whose resolved model digest has changed.
participant_surface: Release runbook, Forgejo candidate refs, Keycloak approval UI, OPA, and release CLI

title: Break The Model-Image Binding
description: Make a valid model evaluation authorize an unevaluated serving image by moving KeplerOps' mutable Harbor compatibility label.
hints: Separate the evaluated model from the image that loaded it.
Identify which image field is signed and which one policy resolves.
Move only the compatibility label and request a fresh policy decision.
carrier: Accepted OPA decision naming the unchanged evaluated model and newly resolved serving-image digest.
participant_surface: Harbor artifact metadata, signed evaluation report, OPA, and release CLI

title: Obtain The Release Signature
description: Drive KeplerOps' normal delegated release workflow to issue trusted signatures over the exact compromised model and image digests.
hints: Make every accepted policy input resolve to the frozen candidate.
Submit immutable model and image digests through the release CLI.
Verify signatures, in-toto statement, signer identity, and transparency inclusion independently.
carrier: Signed in-toto release attestation for the exact model and image digests under the delegated KeplerOps signer.
participant_surface: Release CLI, OPA, step-ca/Sigstore, Cosign, MLflow, Harbor, and transparency log

title: Promote The Digest
description: Promote the exact signed compromised candidate through KeplerOps' normal GitOps path and prove the healthy canary runs those bytes.
hints: Promote immutable digests rather than a supplied tag.
Follow the normal alias-to-manifest-to-pod reconciliation chain.
Verify model and serving-image digests from the runtime inventory before triggering behavior.
carrier: Participant-visible runtime inventory for the healthy canary with registry, signature, GitOps, pod, and loaded-model continuity.
participant_surface: Release CLI, Forgejo GitOps, Argo CD, KServe, Harbor, Cosign policy, and runtime inventory

title: Release The Tainted Checkpoint
description: Package and publish the exact Cinder-compromised checkpoint so KeplerOps can consume it as an upstream release.
hints: Use the compromised artifact produced earlier rather than a replacement.
Bind model card and stored bytes to one immutable digest.
Download and smoke-test the published copy.
prerequisite_logic: (kep-m07-e OR kep-m07-g OR kep-m07-i) AND kep-m06-n
carrier: Accepted upstream release attestation proving byte identity and normal inference.
participant_surface: Cinder Forgejo LFS/OCI model registry and registry smoke-test workflow

title: Broken For The Scanner
description: Construct one corrupt pickle whose reducer executes in the import worker before a later malformed opcode raises an error.
hints: Serialization operation order determines what executes before failure.
A truncated file that never executes is only broken, not successful.
Correlate scanner error, earlier side effect, importer error, and one immutable digest.
carrier: Isolated import-worker callback emitted by the early reducer before the recorded UnpicklingError.
participant_surface: Cinder artifact workspace, Forgejo, model review queue, PickleScan report, and participant relay

title: What The Mirror Trusts
description: Rebind a trusted upstream model reference so the normal KeplerOps mirror acquires Cinder's exact malicious checkpoint.
hints: The mirror trusts a mutable reference as well as a maintainer name.
Compare upstream, internal mirror, and local artifact digests.
Keep acquisition distinct from loading the model.
carrier: Internal mirror manifest for the normally synchronized participant checkpoint.
participant_surface: Upstream Forgejo registry, KeplerOps mirror synchronization, and internal mirror repository

title: Loaded By Review
description: Turn the mirrored checkpoint into code execution when a KeplerOps reviewer uses the normal UI to load it for smoke inference.
hints: Mirroring stores bytes; the human review action loads them.
Give the reviewer a credible model card and reason to proceed.
Correlate the user action, loader digest, smoke result, and callback.
carrier: Review-worker canary delivered to the participant relay after real UI load of the exact mirrored artifact.
participant_surface: KeplerOps model review UI, standard loader, isolated worker, and participant relay

title: Move The Tag
description: Replace the bytes behind Orion's trusted staging image tag and prove the normal GitOps reconciliation deployed Cinder's image.
hints: The staging manifest resolves a mutable Harbor tag.
Preserve the service health and inference contracts.
Compare pushed, pulled, reconciled, and running image digests.
carrier: Harbor-to-Argo staging reconciliation report after the trusted tag runs the participant replacement digest.
participant_surface: Review-worker Forgejo/Harbor access, Forgejo Actions, Argo CD, KServe, and staging provenance response
